CK Asset Holdings Limited

Leasing

Leasing Assistant

Ref.: GLU-LA

  • DSE or above
  • 1 year experience in leasing administration, preferably gained from property developer / property agent / property management company

Property Investment & Valuation

Officer, PI&V

Ref.: PMU-O

Responsibilities: 

  • Responsible for property valuation, researches, land acquisition and planning land administrative matters associated with property development in HK
  • Carry out project feasibility studies and provide recommendations on investment potentials of development projects
  • Conduct external and internal data for property market analysis and prediction
  • Assist in preparing reporting and presentations

Requirements: 

  • Degree or above in Surveying with member of the HKIS or RICS
  • Minimum 2 years’ relevant experience in valuation, property acquisition or related field
  • Good knowledge of relevant property law, prevailing public and private sector valuation and compensation policies and practices
  • Well-organized, good communication & interpersonal skill

Sales / Customer Services

Sales Professionals

Ref.: LFA-SP

  • Post-secondary qualification preferred (Real Estate, Business, Marketing, or related disciplines); equivalent experience considered
  • Minimum 2 years in customer service or sales within property development, agency, or related sectors
  • Candidates with 3+ years' experience in sales launches, pre-sales, and show suite sales management will be considered for senior positions
  • Fresh graduates are warmly welcome to apply — especially those with a proactive mindset, a strong interest in the sales and real estate field, and any hands-on experience with property developers gained during their studies (part-time, internship, show flat, or event support roles)
  • Comprehensive structured training will be provided to fresh graduates to equip them with the product knowledge, sales techniques, and client servicing skills required to thrive in our dynamic sales environment — no prior full-time experience required; we will provide career path to those have potentials
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills
  • Independent, self-motivated, mature, and able to work under pressure during peak launch periods
  • Strong command of written and spoken English and Mandarin
